Today we've optimized memory usage. So, if you have an old PC with low video memory, you should be playing without lags now! In addition, the game size was reduced to 3.7gb

notes.title: Game release and first update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We continue to update the game! I hope you enjoyed the heroic story of our traffic police officer.

List of changes in the update:
[list]
[*] Fixed the logic of the game between the completion of the level and the fight in the ring
[*] Now $ 20 is given for winning the ring, which can automatically complete the level
[*] Free mode was improved (money limit was removed and plot scenes were removed)
[*] The dialog box with the driver ends after 15 seconds, if you have not approached
[*] Cars brake 50cm further from the road
[*] Fixed the movement of cars on the winter map
[*] Small optimization of the winter map
[*] The collision of one of the cars has been fixed (it did not work before)
[*] Removed grass from the road in space
[/ list]

Another update with new content coming soon!
